name: Clockmaker
text: On Recruit: +1 purple per 2 purple you have. Round Start: +1 purple per 2 purple you have.

name: Closer
text: When you place the last minion of the round: +4 purple.

name: Courier
text: Whenever you take an extra turn, +1 of each other color.

name: Shift Crew
text: Worth 2 followers.

name: Early Bird
text: Your turns can’t be skipped.

name: Extra Shift
text: On Recruit: +1 minion this round.

name: Gossip
text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 follower.

name: Late Riser
text: Round Start: if you have the fewest followers (ties count), take an extra turn before anyone places.

name: Night Owl
text: Once per round: after you place your last minion, take an extra turn.

name: Pocket Watch
text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 purple.

name: Go-Getter
text: Once per game: take an extra turn after this one.

name: Hot Streak
text: Once per game: +3 followers per turn in a row you’ve taken just before this one.

name: Timekeepers
text: Game end: +1 follower per purple member you have.

name: Bargain Bin
text: Whenever shop members go to the bottom of the pile, +1 blue.

name: Connoisseur
text: Whenever you recruit a blue member, +1 blue.

name: Critic
text: Whenever a rival recruits a blue member, +1 follower.

name: Doorman
text: Whenever a rival recruits more than once in a turn (swaps count), +1 blue.

name: Patroness
text: Whenever a shop member goes to the bottom of the pile, +1 follower.

name: Plus-One
text: On Recruit: recruit again this turn.

name: Regular
text: Whenever you buy followers, +1 blue.

name: Restocker
text: Once per game: send the whole shop to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Shopaholic
text: You can always recruit twice.
